svg.text: Threshold rule added to metrics.py — e.g. Tg > 400 °C = feasible (positive class)
True positive (TP) — predicted feasible and actually feasible
True negative (TN) — predicted infeasible and actually infeasible
False positive (FP) — predicted feasible but actually infeasible
False negative (FN) — predicted infeasible but actually feasible
Derived: precision = TP/(TP+FP) · recall = TP/(TP+FN) · F1 = 2×P×R/(P+R)
New file: classification_metrics.py — all of the above + confusion matrix display
